description: React component for configuring rate limiting settings in a chatflow, including enabling/disabling rate limit, setting message limit, duration, and message, with save functionality and API integration.

methods.name: formatObj
methods.description: Prepares the API configuration object with current rate limit settings, validating input fields.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates the rateLimitStatus state based on user toggle.

methods.name: checkDisabled
methods.description: Determines if the Save button should be disabled based on input validation.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the current rate limit configuration via API call and updates chatflow state.

methods.name: onTextChanged
methods.description: Updates state variables for rate limit input fields based on user input.

methods.name: textField
methods.description: Renders input fields for rate limit parameters with labels and placeholders.
